chunks: Their arrogance in the land and the plotting of the evil one. And the evil plot will not encompass except its people. So what do they await but the way of the former? You will not find for the law of God any change, nor will you find for the law of God any alteration.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God's Sunnah cannot be changed or altered?
ai.summary: This passage highlights the divine principle of *Sunnat Allah* (God's customary way), asserting that the fate of the arrogant who engage in *makr* (plotting) is inevitable retribution upon themselves. In Shia exegesis, this immutable 'way' underscores the consistency of divine justice across history, serving as a warning that human efforts to alter divine decree are futile.
